Sword & Shield series · RCL

Rebel Clash

Released May 1, 2020 · 209 cards

Expanded

Rebel Clash is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on May 1, 2020. Its main set has 192 cards, plus 17 secret rares numbered beyond the set (209 in total). It includes 176 Pokémon, 28 Trainer and 5 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

75 illustrators worked on Rebel Clash. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (28), aky CG Works (11), Kouki Saitou (6), Akira Komayama (5), kirisAki (5), Mitsuhiro Arita (5), nagimiso (5), Hideki Ishikawa (4).
